notes.title: Speedrunning competition!
notes.content:
The speedrunning competition will run for the first month, from the 19th of January to the 19th of February. The prize pool is 30% of the first month's sales.

[list]
[*] 1st place will receive 15% (as of 22/01/24 $44.1)
[*] 2nd place will receive 10% (as of 22/01/24 $29.4)
[*] 3rd place will receive 5% (as of 22/01/24 $14.7)
[/list]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]

[h3]What map should I play on?[/h3]
The regular map.

[h3]Where should I submit my runs?[/h3]
The runs are hosted on the speedrun.com/Jumpfox_Always_Running

[h3]I won, what next?[/h3]
I will contact you via speedrun.com, make sure you dms are open. Please ensure that the account contacting you is https://www.speedrun.com/users/tarabara. I will prefer to pay in cryptocurrencies of your choice, but payment to a bank account is also an option. I will cover all the fees. Please be aware of scammers, trying to take advantage of you. You will not be paid immediately, as first it takes time for steam to transfer funds to the developers.

[h3]Is everyone allowed to participate?[/h3]
You may not participate if you are a resident of these countries (sorry, nothing personal, but I will get into legal trouble otherwise): Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Belarus, Syria, Yemen, Lebanon, Iraq, Venezuela, Sudan.

[h3]I still have questions[/h3]
Join the Discord server at https://discord.gg/gPA9FqfPpt or contact me via email at tarabara.maksym7@gmail.com. I'll do my best to respond as soon as possible.
